method_notes: Horse Creek (Kaweah) and Trimmer (Pine Flat) are flood-control reservoirs photographed at deep drawdown. Both were called lakefront by measuring to the OSM full-pool line (1-11 m from the pads, open ground between), per the rule that drawdown never downgrades; each note says how far off the water usually is.

Three canopy-blind creek campgrounds (Four Jeffrey, Big Meadows, Chapman) had OSM creek lines within 4-40 m of pads but no per-site water flag or agency site map; held at not waterfront (Four Jeffrey's creek also runs inside a dense riparian band).
Hume Lake, Dorabelle and Cottage Creek are lakeview on the agency's own 'some sites have views of the lake' statement, with the pads 120-330 m back.
